title: Silas and the Wolf
author: Mara Lockridge
blurb: Noor Nystrom, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
